_comment: Merge into static/lang/en.json under FALLOUT.PowerArmor — these extend the existing namespace, they do not replace it. Every key below is new; nothing here collides with the keys already shipped (verified against en.json at v0.18.0). The drain reasons teslaCoils, jetPack, explosiveVent and manual already exist and are now actually reached.

entry.robot: A Robot cannot use Power Armor at all (pg 9).
entry.needsFitting: A Super Mutant cannot use Power Armor unless it is modded to their body type (pg 11) — this suit needs the Super Mutant Fitting upgrade (pg 59).
entry.fittedOut: This suit carries the Super Mutant Fitting: humans and ghouls can no longer use it (pg 59). Removing the fitting costs the same price or crafting materials again.

PowerArmor.suitTraits: Hydraulic Machine and Longer Strides: Strength counts as 12, size is {size}, and a sprint carries {sprint} feet instead of 50 (+{strides}). Size {size} is reported, not enforced — nothing in this system tracks a creature's size.
PowerArmor.noUpgrade: This suit does not have {upgrade} at the rank that ability requires (pg 59).
PowerArmor.ceasedControl: The suit has ceased function — slot a fresh Fusion Core before using its upgrades.
PowerArmor.upgradesHint: The pg 59 Power Armor upgrades, by rank. Ranks are cumulative and each costs the base price again (pg 58); attaching or removing one takes 15 minutes, not the 1 minute a regular armor upgrade takes.
PowerArmor.syncUpgradesHint: Rebuild the Active Effects a suit's upgrades grant. Run it after editing a rank by hand.
PowerArmor.spendTimeHint: Charge the suit minutes of operation. The book prints a total per suit model and never a base drain rate, so time only passes when someone says it does.
PowerArmor.teslaOn: Switches the Tesla Coils on ({ap} AP). Each creature within {radius} feet takes {damage} electricity damage now and at the start of their turns; the coils burn {minutes} minutes of allotted time each round they stay on (pg 59).
PowerArmor.teslaOff: Switches the Tesla Coils off ({ap} AP).
PowerArmor.teslaDamage: Tesla Coils — every creature within {radius} feet. The book also charges this at the start of each of *their* turns, which this system does not iterate; re-roll it then.
PowerArmor.jetPackFlight: Flies {feet} feet on the Jet Pack ({ap} AP). The book charges 1 minute of allotted time per 10 feet flown "or every second that you fly" — two different rates; distance is what is charged here, rounded up.
PowerArmor.ventFired: Vents explosively on landing — the upgrade requires a fall of at least {fall} feet, which nothing here can measure. Each creature within {radius} feet takes {damage} fire damage and {damage} explosive damage, and the suit loses {minutes} minutes of allotted time (pg 59).
PowerArmor.ventDamage: Explosive vent — every creature within {radius} feet.
PowerArmor.overclockSelf: Deliberately overheats the fusion core ({ap} AP, Overclock Hydraulics rank 2, pg 59).
PowerArmor.overclockActive: Overclock Hydraulics: while overheated you can also move {feet} feet for {ap} AP and your unarmed attacks deal an additional {damage} fire damage (pg 59). Both are reported — this system has no movement budget and no unarmed damage rider.
PowerArmor.bracers: A powerful unarmed attack with Optimized bracers ({ap} AP, {damage} bludgeoning, pg 59). Roll the attack as an ordinary unarmed attack.
PowerArmor.bracersPush: At rank 3 it also pushes the target 15 feet back.
PowerArmor.kineticDynamo: Kinetic dynamo returns {ap} AP for the {decay} level(s) of decay the suit took since the last turn (pg 59).

manual.explosiveShielding: Reduces explosive damage taken by 5 / 10 / 15. Applied when damage is dealt, if the damage pipeline is wired to the suit's shielding.
manual.prismShielding: Reduces laser and plasma damage taken by 5 / 10 / 20. The printed ranks read 5 / 5 / 10; taken as totals, rank 2 would buy nothing, so they are read cumulatively.
manual.reactivePlates: A melee attacker takes a quarter of the damage they dealt, rounded down, twice over at rank 2; at rank 3 they are knocked 15 feet. Reported — this system applies damage to the target the GM has selected, and the attacker is not it.
manual.vatsMatrix: Every targeted attack's additional AP cost drops by 1 per rank, to a floor of 0. The Fusion Core's +5 becomes +3 at rank 2.
manual.targetingHud: 3 AP marks a creature (one, or three at rank 2); damage you deal to a marked creature adds a die, two dice at rank 3. Not automated: a mark is state about another creature, and the extra die belongs to the attack roll.
manual.headlamp: 1 AP for a 40 foot bright cone and 40 more of dim, +10 feet per rank; at rank 3 it blinds creatures within 5 feet if lit in darkness. Not automated: light is token configuration, which this system has never touched.
manual.rustyKnuckles: An unarmed hit makes the target bleed. Not automated: applying Bleeding needs the attack roll to know it landed and on whom.
manual.emergencyProtocolsMove: Rank 1: while under half your hit points you can spend 1 AP to move 10 feet. Not automated: nothing here meters movement.
manual.superMutantFitting: Fits the suit to a Super Mutant. Humans and ghouls can no longer wear it; entering is gated on both counts. Removal costs the same price or materials again.
